DLC2315:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...One lesson mothers teach their children is not to pick up things lying on the ground.」

DLC2315:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But sometimes unexpected treasure lies buried... Captivated by that romance, people go searching for hidden fortunes that may not even exist.」

DLC2315:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The story I'm about to tell takes place just after we heard of the darkness of the $$黒歴史$$ from $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$ on the moon.」

DLC2315:3:t_1:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ロラン$$ and $$ガロード$$... The two who lived in worlds after the era called the $$黒歴史$$ seem to have found an answer to a question that had long troubled them.」

DLC2315:3:t_1:12.en:
$$ロラン$$
「$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$'s story made everything clear. The world we came from... the future after the so-called $$黒歴史$$, was connected to the world we're in now, too.」

DLC2315:3:t_1:14.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Didn't the era called the $$黒歴史$$ come about when $$ＵＣＷ$$ met the worst possible fate?」

DLC2315:3:t_1:15.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's what I thought, too... But it looks like that era wasn't made up of $$ＵＣＷ$$ alone.」

DLC2315:3:t_1:16.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Here's what backs that up. After we fought the $$エグゼクター$$, something happened...」

DLC2315:3:t_2:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「...So this time, you're really sealing the $$ホワイトドール$$ away.」

DLC2315:3:t_2:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「After what happened with the $$エグゼクター$$, I really think it's dangerous to keep using relics of the $$黒歴史$$ like this.」

DLC2315:3:t_2:6.en:
$$ジャミル$$
「What did Queen $$ディアナ$$ say?」

DLC2315:3:t_2:7.en:
$$キエル$$
「She respected $$ロラン$$'s decision and gave her permission to let the $$ホワイトドール$$ sleep in the abandoned mine at $$ビシニティ$$.」

DLC2315:3:t_2:10.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It's fine... If that's what you've decided, $$ロラン$$, it's not for me to argue.」

DLC2315:3:t_2:11.en:
$$ジャミル$$
「Though it does make me feel a little lonely.」

DLC2315:3:t_2:12.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「We feel the same way. So we're taking one last photograph here, to preserve our memories of fighting alongside the $$ホワイトドール$$.」

DLC2315:3:t_2:13.en:
$$パーラ$$
「But it seems like such a waste. You're stopping the $$マウンテンサイクル$$ excavations, too, right?」

DLC2315:3:t_2:14.en:
$$キエル$$
「We have no need to look back at the past. Even if we pursue mechanization, there are other ways to do it.」

DLC2315:3:t_2:15.en:
$$キエル$$
「We no longer need the relics of the $$黒歴史$$.」

DLC2315:3:t_2:17.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$キッド$$ and $$ウィッツ$$ haven't quite let go, though. They went up into the mountains for one last survey.」

DLC2315:3:t_2:18.en:
$$パーラ$$
「It's pretty petty, isn't it? Trying to make a business out of stuff you pick up.」

DLC2315:3:t_2:19.en:
$$ガロード$$
「But I get how $$キッド$$ feels. The $$エグゼクター$$ proved it, too... There must still be things we don't know about sleeping in the $$マウンテンサイクル$$.」

DLC2315:3:t_2:20.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Lady $$ディアナ$$ said that further study of the $$マウンテンサイクル$$ would help us understand the $$黒歴史$$ in more detail.」

DLC2315:3:t_2:21.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But now that $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$ has chosen to sleep, she seems to believe humanity should move toward the future instead of looking back at the past.」

DLC2315:3:t_2:22.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah. That's why $$ティファ$$ and I got rid of all the $$Ｇビット$$s, too.」

DLC2315:3:t_2:23.en:
$$ティファ$$
「That's... a power we mustn't use.」

DLC2315:3:t_2:24.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「But if too much power is dangerous, isn't $$ガロード$$'s $$ダブルエックス$$ the same?」

DLC2315:3:t_2:26.en:
$$ジャミル$$
「Excuse me... A transmission from the $$フリーデン$$.」

DLC2315:3:t_2:27.en:
$$サラ$$
「This is $$サラ$$ aboard the $$フリーデン$$! Please respond!」

DLC2315:3:t_2:28.en:
$$ジャミル$$
「This is $$ジャミル$$. Has something happened?」

DLC2315:3:t_2:29.en:
$$サラ$$
「While we were surveying the $$マウンテンサイクル$$, unidentified mobile suits emerged from the ruins and began attacking us!」

DLC2315:3:t_2:31.en:
$$サラ$$
「$$ウィッツ$$, $$ロアビィ$$, $$エニル$$ and $$メシェー$$ are intercepting them, but they were caught by surprise and won't hold out much longer!」

DLC2315:3:t_2:32.en:
$$サラ$$
「Captain, $$ガロード$$, $$パーラ$$! Please join us immediately!」

DLC2315:3:t_2:34.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Damn it! More things like the $$エグゼクター$$?!」

DLC2315:3:t_2:35.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「$$ロラン$$! We're going, too...!」

DLC2315:3:t_2:36.en:
$$ロラン$$
「We don't know how the situation will develop! Miss $$ソシエ$$, please stay here and protect Miss $$キエル$$!」

DLC2315:3:t_2:38.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Relics of the $$黒歴史$$... Do we have to fight them again...?」

DLC2315:3:t_3:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...Then the machines that came out of that $$マウンテンサイクル$$ were mobile suits from $$マリーメイア$$'s army and $$ネオ・ジオン$$?」

DLC2315:3:t_3:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「They were covered in mud and damaged all over, so I wasn't certain before. But now I can say that's what they were.」

DLC2315:3:t_3:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「To think the world we're in now was part of the $$黒歴史$$, too...」

DLC2315:3:t_3:9.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「I can't poke fun at $$シン$$ this time. I'm getting confused, too.」

DLC2315:3:t_3:10.en:
$$ガロード$$
「D-don't ask me! I'm just telling you what happened!」

DLC2315:3:t_3:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「There's no point dwelling on it. It's already in the past.」

DLC2315:3:t_3:13.en:
$$ロラン$$
「What we have to do is make sure the people who come after us don't call the time we're living in now the $$黒歴史$$.」

DLC2315:3:t_3:16.en:
$$ロラン$$
（What we seek isn't a dark history, but a future full of hope.）

DLC2315:3:t_3:17.en:
$$ロラン$$
（I'm off, Lady $$ディアナ$$... To protect this world's future.）

DLC2315:3:t_3:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...A sealed-away past, a black history... Those words have come to be used in all sorts of situations in all sorts of worlds.」

DLC2315:3:t_3:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Perhaps even this very moment will become a time we'd rather seal away when we look back on it someday.」

DLC2315:3:t_3:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... As long as I'm enjoying the present, it's all fine by me...」

DLC2315:3:t_3:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And with that, everyone... Until we meet again.」

DLC2315:4:t_000:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「What about $$ウィッツ$$, $$ロアビィ$$ and the others?」

DLC2315:4:t_000:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「The $$エアマスター$$ and $$レオパルド$$ took heavy damage in the first battle. They can't sortie.」

DLC2315:4:t_000:2.en:
$$パーラ$$
「The $$フリーデン$$ was attacked, too, and $$ジャミル$$'s X got hit while it was in the hangar.」

DLC2315:4:t_000:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「$$メシェー$$ and the others are defending the town and evacuating the residents...」

DLC2315:4:t_000:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「The $$連邦軍$$ are tied up dealing with the aftermath of the $$エグゼクター$$ incident. We have to stop the enemy's all-out attack ourselves.」

DLC2315:4:t_001:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I can't believe that many mechanical dolls were still buried in the $$マウンテンサイクル$$...!」

DLC2315:4:t_001:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「They look like mobile suits, but I've never seen any of these types!」

DLC2315:4:t_001:3.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Are those $$エグゼクター$$s, too?」

DLC2315:4:t_001:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「When the Master System stopped, every $$エグゼクター$$ in the world shut down. I think these are something else.」

DLC2315:4:t_001:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Whatever they are, we'll stop them! If we let those things run loose, they'll burn down $$ノックス$$, too!」

DLC2315:4:t_001:6.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Yes! We have to stop them here!」

DLC2315:4:t_002:0.en:
$$パーラ$$
「This is bad, $$ガロード$$, $$ロラン$$! More of them!」

review.context: Loran and Garrod explain how buried machines linked their post-Black-History world with the current world. A flashback revisits the planned sealing of White Doll and a Mountain Cycle attack.
decisions: The Black History is a specific era when tokenized; AG also uses black history as the general idea of an embarrassing past.
Sochie questions Double X's dangerous power, but an incoming call interrupts Garrod's answer.
The final present-day discussion frames history as a future responsibility rather than a chronology the characters fully understand.
